checks.hypothesis: Every source listed as read in full exists (hashes recorded)
Every basis ID resolves (SSSC Cycles A-D, phases, main reports, links, factors, sources)
Every source ID resolves to an existing register entry (no invented sources)
Every source a claim lists is cited by one of its basis items
No claim or link is labelled above its weakest ranked basis
Every owner claim is marked as the owner's, labelled H or PS, and quotes the Work Queue verbatim
Every census claim states the value the tool computes
Judgment rows are well-formed (incl. factor bases from the topic's own ledger or main report, audit verdicts)
Every non-census, non-owner, non-framing claim has an anchor phrase found verbatim in a basis item
No source ID means different sources in the main and track registers
No tradition claim is labelled Plausible or Hypothetical, and every Established one is marked descriptive
Every claim and link of the previous cycle has a review verdict
Every review verdict matches the change made (keep unchanged, revise same label, downgrade lower label, withdraw absent; new items marked new)
Every tradition claim (framing aside) cites a source other than the owner's framework
No Established claim or link has a basis item below Established (Report 7's strict rule)
No Established claim or link rests on a PS or H basis or on the framing source (Report 7's separability test)
Every main-report link among Reports 2-5 is carried by a non-census claim or link
At least one factor is present in all four topics under this iteration's rule
At least one substantive or tradition factor is present in all four topics under this iteration's rule
Every pair of topics has at least one Connection link
No 80-character overlap with the Totality Suite
